biggest_catch: The friend must complete a demanding 60-day checklist - 15+ debit card transactions of at least $10 each AND $250+ in direct deposits within 60 days of account opening - or the referral pays nothing.
catches: Friend must register via the referral email/social link, open a new OnPath CU personal or business checking account, then within 60 days make 15+ debit card transactions (excluding ATM) of $10+ each AND receive $250+ in direct deposits.
Referrer must be a current OnPath Credit Union member in good standing and register for the existing-member OnPath ReferLive Checking Account Program.
A Referrer may receive up to five (5) $150 Visa Reward Cards ($750 value) within a calendar year; one account per Referred person per Referrer.
Reward is a Visa Reward Card (not cash) - subject to the card's own terms and conditions, and OnPath/ReferLive are not responsible for lost, stolen or expired cards.
Allow 4-6 weeks after completion of all requirements for delivery of the Visa Reward Card.
Visa Reward Cards may be reported as income to the IRS.
$150 per referral applies during the promotional period starting July 14th, 2025; offer subject to change without notice.
